description: The file defines the EmployeeEvent entity class in PHP, which maps to the 'ohrm_employee_event' database table within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It contains properties for event details such as type, note, date, and associations to an employee, with ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: EmployeeEvent
classes.description: Represents an employee-related event with properties for event type, note, date, and associated employee, mapped via Doctrine ORM annotations to its database table.

methods.name: getEventId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the event.

methods.name: setEventId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the event.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number associated with the event.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number associated with the event.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the event.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves the note associated with the event.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note for the event.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the event.

methods.name: setCreatedDate
methods.description: Sets the creation date of the event.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the username who created the event.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the username who created the event.
